hypothesis: entering at the close of the announcement minute of a Binance futures-perpetual launch (token already on spot) and holding 60 minutes beats matched altcoins after a 0.4% round trip (Binance spot, 112 valid events 2020-2023)
note: Mean excess +0.53% (t 0.91); delayed 5 min: -0.16% (t -0.36); net after 0.4% round trip -0.02%. The whole move happens inside the announcement minute: +3.28% excess in that one bar, flat afterwards (+3.79% at 60 min, +4.17% at 24 h), no pre-announcement drift (the published time is accurate to the minute). A reaction exists and is large; an entry after the minute misses it. 20 grid cells reported; the best (entry in the announcement minute, 15-minute hold) has t 2.1.
